description: This file implements a job scheduling mechanism for one-time jobs within the Mattermost server, including job creation, execution, cancellation, and metadata management.

classes.name: JobOnceMetadata
classes.description: Struct holding metadata for a one-time job, including key, scheduled run time, and properties.

classes.name: JobOnce
classes.description: Struct representing a scheduled one-time job with methods for execution, cancellation, and metadata management.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Terminates the scheduled job and removes it from the store.

methods.name: newJobOnce
methods.description: Creates a new JobOnce instance with provided parameters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop to wait until the scheduled time and execute the job.

methods.name: executeJob
methods.description: Executes the stored callback for the job.

methods.name: readMetadata
methods.description: Reads job metadata from the key-value store.

methods.name: saveMetadata
methods.description: Saves job metadata to the key-value store.

methods.name: cancelWhileHoldingMutex
methods.description: Cancels the job while holding its mutex, removing it from store and active jobs.
